response_data.title: Encampment Commander
response_data.summary: Overall commander responsible for the entire encampment operation.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Provide strategic leadership and vision for encampment
- Ensure safety and welfare of all participants
- Coordinate with Wing and Region leadership
- Final authority on all encampment matters
- Conduct commander's calls and briefings
- Approve all major decisions

response_data.title: SM Superintendent
response_data.summary: Senior Member Superintendent - supports commander with senior member coordination.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Coordinate senior member staff activities
- Serve as liaison between cadets and senior members
- Assist with administrative functions
- Support commander as needed

response_data.title: Finance
response_data.summary: Manages all financial operations for encampment.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Track all income and expenses
- Process registration payments
- Manage budget allocations
- Prepare financial reports
- Handle vendor payments

response_data.title: Chaplain/CDI
response_data.summary: Provides spiritual support and character development instruction.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Conduct religious services
- Provide counseling support
- Lead character development sessions
- Support cadet welfare

response_data.title: Health Services
response_data.summary: Oversees all medical support and health services.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Manage medical staff and supplies
- Coordinate emergency medical response
- Track medications and health records
- Conduct health screenings
- Ensure AED and first aid readiness

response_data.title: Safety
response_data.summary: Ensures safety compliance throughout encampment operations.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Conduct safety briefings and inspections
- Monitor activity safety compliance
- Investigate and report incidents
- Maintain safety documentation
- Coordinate with health services

response_data.title: Commandant
response_data.summary: Senior Member overseeing all cadet training operations.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Supervise Cadet Commander and training staff
- Ensure training objectives are met
- Coordinate training schedule execution
- Evaluate cadet performance
- Maintain discipline standards

response_data.title: Cadet Commander
response_data.summary: Senior cadet leader commanding the cadet corps.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Lead cadet staff and corps
- Execute training plan
- Set example for all cadets
- Conduct formations and inspections
- Report to Commandant and EC

response_data.title: Deputy Comm for Support
response_data.summary: Oversees all support and logistics functions.
response_data.responsibilities:
- Supervise support staff sections
- Manage facilities and resources
- Coordinate transportation and logistics
- Oversee communications and PA
